newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stock indices recover losses to close up.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stock indices recover losses to close up.

text.p: Madrid stock indices recovered earlier losses to climb higher into the close on Friday after a rollercoaster session. Key stocks managed to shake off the negative influence of Wall Street losses in late trade.
The general index closed up 2.44 points, 0.54 percent, to 456.42. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares advanced 27.25 points, 0.52 percent, to 5,258.68.
"The market was very strong as demonstrated this afternoon when all other European bourses fell together with Wall Street and we rose," said one trader.
Traders said stronger than expected U.S. jobs data had revived U.S. rate fears and sent stock markets tumbling.
Turnover remained high at over 100 billion pesetas, although almost a quarter of this was attributable to block trades particularly in Telefonica.
By the close Telefonica had slipped 35 pesetas to 3,240 after the government announced it had approved a golden share in the privatisation of its final 21 percent stake.
Trading in Repsol and Endesa shares had a strong upward influence on indices. Repsol rose 170 pesetas to 9,850 while Endesa ended 350 pesetas higher at 9,850.
